calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jul-26-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Denise Doucette.
Petitioners: Jorge Vargas Aguilar and Maria Curz Vargas, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Jorge Antonio Vargas and Priscila Yanderi Vargas, and with Spanish Interpreter: Dennis Bonilla.
Petitioners and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Jorge Antonio Vargas Cruz and Priscila Yanderi Vargas Cruz.
Decree signed in open court.
